verdict.rationale: Gecko documents a hybrid deployment where the scanner, S3 storage, and all AI inference run in the customer's AWS account. Its release endpoint returns digest-pinned images to pull, and the pricing page lists an "On-prem / self-hosted / private cloud" option. However, the documented hybrid mode keeps the dashboard, database, and orchestration Gecko-hosted, and there is no documentation of a fully self-hosted deployment. Missing for 10: documented full self-hosting of the dashboard, database, and orchestration; install or ops guides for on-prem; independent or hands-on corroboration of self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
